name: Charizard
history: Charizard is a Fire/Flying-type Pokémon. It is the final evolution of Charmander and is known for its powerful fire breath and its dragon-like appearance.

name: Squirtle
history: Squirtle is a Water-type Pokémon. It is one of the original starter Pokémon and is known for the water cannons on its back.

name: Jigglypuff
history: Jigglypuff is a Normal/Fairy-type Pokémon known for its ability to sing and put its target to sleep.

name: Gengar
history: Gengar is a Ghost/Poison-type Pokémon known for its mischievous and eerie nature. It can pass through walls and has a sinister grin.

name: Pikachu
history: Pikachu is an Electric-type Pokémon known for its lightning bolt-shaped tail. It is one of the most iconic and beloved Pokémon, often recognized as the franchise's mascot.

name: Bulbasaur
history: Bulbasaur is a Grass/Poison-type Pokémon. It is the first Pokémon in the National Pokédex and is known for the plant bulb on its back, which grows into a large flower as it evolves.

name: Machamp
history: Machamp is a Fighting-type Pokémon. It is known for its incredible physical strength and its multiple arms, which it uses to deliver devastating punches.

name: Gyarados
history: Gyarados is a Water/Flying-type Pokémon. It is known for its destructive temperament and its ability to cause massive storms when angered.

name: Alakazam
history: Alakazam is a Psychic-type Pokémon. It possesses an astonishingly high IQ and uses psychic powers to manipulate objects and its opponents.

name: Lapras
history: Lapras is a Water/Ice-type Pokémon. It is known for its gentle nature and its ability to carry people on its back across bodies of water.

name: Mewtwo
history: Mewtwo is a genetically engineered Psychic-type Pokémon. It is incredibly intelligent and possesses immense psychic power.

name: Machop
history: Machop is a Fighting-type Pokémon. It is known for its powerful muscles and its relentless training regimen.

name: Snorlax
history: Snorlax is a Normal-type Pokémon known for its immense size and appetite. It spends most of its time sleeping and blocking paths.

name: Eevee
history: Eevee is a Normal-type Pokémon known for its ability to evolve into various different forms based on its environment and friendship.

name: Pidgeot
history: Pidgeot is a Flying-type Pokémon known for its impressive speed and powerful wings. It is the final evolution of Pidgey.

name: Golem
history: Golem is a Rock/Ground-type Pokémon known for its incredible physical defense and resistance to physical attacks.

name: Dragonite
history: Dragonite es un Pokémon de tipo Dragón/Volador conocido por su naturaleza amable y gentil. A pesar de su tamaño, se sabe que rescata a personas perdidas en el mar.

name: Arcanine
history: Arcanine es un Pokémon de tipo Fuego conocido por su majestuosidad y lealtad. A menudo se le llama un Pokémon legendario.

name: Dragonite
history: Dragonite is a Dragon/Flying-type Pokémon known for its kind and gentle nature. Despite its size, it is known to rescue people lost at sea.

name: Arcanine
history: Arcanine is a Fire-type Pokémon known for its majesty and loyalty. It is often referred to as a legendary Pokémon.

name: Mew
history: Mew is a Psychic-type Pokémon known for its mysterious and mythical nature. It is said to possess the genetic code of all Pokémon.

name: Weedle
history: Weedle is a Bug/Poison-type Pokémon with a distinctive needle on its head. It evolves into Kakuna and later into Beedrill.

name: Vulpix
history: Vulpix is a Fire-type Pokémon known for its fox-like appearance. It evolves into Ninetales, gaining mystical powers with age.

name: Ninetales
history: Ninetales is a Fire-type Pokémon known for its mystical powers and majestic appearance.
